method: Reviewed reuse of historical built-in imagegen sources; authorized alpha-only background extraction and figure separation. No recoloring or replacement of installed art.

items.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create the Sun Sentinel cosmetic skin for the exact female ninja in the base SD and LD references. Costume only: warm ivory and amber gold ceremonial armor over dark trousers. Preserve recognizable face, eye shape/color, hair color/style, signature weapon or magical prop and age presentation. Use each base reference's own natural anatomy, proportions, expression, stance and cel-shaded dark linework; do not impose a universal head-to-body ratio. Do not use the rejected lv01-b cleanup redraw as reference. The SD and LD versions must depict identical costume construction, palette and accessories; keep a consistent identity and do not change the face between variants. Make the costume distinct in construction, not just recolored. Output only the explicitly requested SD or LD variant as one full-body sprite on its own canvas with all weapons and shoes inside the margin. Actual transparent RGBA required. No white backdrop substitute or painted checkerboard. No stiff mannequin stance, generic doll face, glossy 3D rendering, exaggerated anatomy, ground shadow, labels or watermark.
